open.title: Open Memoria and find your way around
open.summary: Where Memoria is, how the tabs are organised and how to get back to the start.
open.keywords: open start begin login enter where find menu tabs navigate navigation move around home first time beginner how to use
steps: Sign in to Mi Hacienda as usual.
In the dark bar at the top of any page, click "Memoria" (next to the small tree icon). You can also go to "Admin" and click the first button, "Memoria".
Memoria always opens on the tab "🏠 Today".

Below the title you see a row of tabs in three groups: "Governance" (meetings, decisions, tasks, deadlines), "Suppliers & spending" (suppliers, quotes, contracts, invoices, budget) and "Reports" (Ask Memoria, Overview, Handover pack, Activity, Export, Help).
Click a tab to open it. The tab you are in has an orange line under it.
To come back to the start, click "🏠 Today". If you reload the page, Memoria also returns to "Today".
tips: Only board members can see Memoria. Owners never see it.
Memoria uses the language you chose in the top bar (EN, ES, FR, DE).
Lost? Click "❓ Help" and type your question in your own words.

today.title: Understand the Today screen
today.summary: What the first screen shows: key numbers, what needs attention, the next meeting and the next 30 days.
today.keywords: today home dashboard overview summary start screen what needs attention alerts warnings red orange dot next meeting deadlines spending recent activity
steps: Click "🏠 Today".
At the top you see four boxes with numbers: "Open tasks", "Deadlines in 30 days", "Active contracts" and "Spent in" this year. Click a box to open the tab behind it.

Below is "🔔 Needs attention": a list of things that need action, for example an overdue task or a contract whose notice deadline is close. A red dot means urgent or overdue, orange means coming up, grey is information.
Click any line in "Needs attention" to go straight to the record.
The card "🗓️ Next meeting" shows the next planned meeting and whether the invitation deadline is met. Click it to open the meeting.
The card "📅 Next 30 days" lists upcoming deadlines. "See all →" opens the Calendar.
"💶 Spending in" shows this year's invoices by category, and "🕒 Recent activity" shows the latest changes.
At the bottom, the buttons "💬 Ask Memoria" and "📦 Prepare handover pack" open those tools.
tips: Memoria only reports facts from the records. It never tells the board what to decide.

demo.title: What "DEMO" means
demo.summary: Records marked DEMO are invented sample data for the presentation and will be deleted.
demo.keywords: demo sample example fake fictional test data orange badge dashed delete sample data presentation
steps: Records with a small dashed orange "DEMO" badge are invented examples, so you can see how Memoria works.
While sample data exists, a dashed orange box under the title says "DEMO · Records marked DEMO are fictional sample data…".
DEMO records are never sent in the automatic e-mails.
When Memoria goes into real use, all DEMO records are deleted in one step. Your real records stay.
tips: When you import something only to try it out, tick "Mark as DEMO (sample data)" so it is deleted with the other samples.

ask.title: Ask Memoria a question in your own words
ask.summary: Type a question and Memoria answers from its records and the Statutes, and can show you where to click.
ask.keywords: ask question chat assistant ai search find answer how where what who when cost history why explain help me
steps: Click the tab "💬 Ask Memoria" (or the button "💬 Ask Memoria" on Today).
Before your first question you see example questions. Click one to try it.
Or type your own question in the box at the bottom, in your own words. For example: "Where can I see all quotes for pool cleaning, and how do I compare them?"
Click "Ask" (or press Enter). Wait a few seconds while "Memoria is looking through the records…" is shown.
Read the answer. If it explains how to do something, it shows buttons that open the right screen or the step-by-step guide.
Ask a follow-up question in the same box; Memoria remembers the last few messages.
Click "New conversation" to start again.
tips: Memoria answers only from what is recorded. If data is missing (for example invoices not yet imported), it says so.
It never decides for the board and never changes anything.
Each board member can ask up to 200 questions a day.

task-new.title: Add a task: who does what, by when
task-new.summary: Every resolution gets a person responsible, a board member who checks it, and a deadline.
task-new.keywords: task todo to do follow up follow-up action resolution responsible deadline due date assign who does what create new add
steps: Click the tab "✅ Follow-up".
Click "+ New task" (right side, above the list).
Type the "Title", for example "Ask 3 quotes for the garage door".
In "Resolution / decision", choose the decision this task comes from (if there is one).
Choose "Carried out by (role)" (for example "Administrator") and type the "Name / company".
In "Checked by (board member)" type the board member who follows it up.
Choose the "Due date" and, if it is important, set "Priority" to "High".
Click "Save". The task now appears in the list, in the Calendar, on Today and in the weekly e-mail.
tips: Tasks are also created automatically when you import minutes or record a decision from a meeting.

task-progress.title: Record progress on a task, mark it blocked or done
task-progress.summary: Change the status of a task and keep a short history of what happened.
task-progress.keywords: task progress update status done finished complete blocked stuck note history in progress close task mark done
steps: Click the tab "✅ Follow-up" and find the task (use "Search…" if the list is long).
To add a note: click "▸ Show details" on the task, type in the box under "Progress" (for example "3 quotes requested, answers by 15/10") and click "Add note".
To change the status: use the small drop-down on the right of the task card.
Choose "In progress" when work starts. A small window asks for an optional note; click OK.
Choose "Blocked" if it is stuck. You must type why; the task then appears in "Needs attention".
Choose "Done" when it is finished. Memoria records today's date as "Completed on" and moves the task to "Done".
tips: The four boxes at the top ("Open", "Overdue", "Blocked", "Done") are filters: click one to see only those tasks. Click "All" to see everything.

obligation-new.title: Add a recurring deadline (inspection, insurance, legal duty)
obligation-new.summary: Memoria reminds the board of inspections, insurance renewals and other recurring duties.
obligation-new.keywords: calendar deadline recurring obligation inspection insurance renewal lift elevator fire extinguisher pool certificate legal duty reminder yearly monthly annual
steps: Click the tab "📅 Calendar".
Click "+ New obligation" (right side).
Type the "Title", for example "Lift inspection".
Choose the "Category" (for example "Technical inspection" or "Insurance").
Choose the "Next due" date and how often it "Repeats" (for example "Yearly").
In "Remind (days before)" keep 30 or change it.
Optionally fill "Basis (law, statutes, contract)", "Responsible", "Supplier" and "Contract".
Click "Save". The deadline now appears in the Calendar, on Today and in the reminder e-mails.
tips: Meeting deadlines from the Statutes and contract notice deadlines are calculated automatically; you do not need to add them.

obligation-done.title: Mark an inspection or other obligation as done
obligation-done.summary: Record that it was done, with evidence; Memoria moves the next date forward.
obligation-done.keywords: calendar obligation done completed inspection passed certificate evidence issues found next date mark as done
steps: Click the tab "📅 Calendar", then the switch "Recurring obligations".
Find the obligation and click "✓ Mark as done".
Check the date in "Done on".
In "Evidence (certificate, report no.)" type the certificate or report number.
If problems were found, describe them in "Issues found".
Click "Save". The next due date moves forward automatically.
If you wrote issues, Memoria asks whether to create a follow-up task. Click OK to create it.
tips: Attach the certificate: click "▸ Show details" on the obligation, then "+ Add attachment".

meeting-plan.title: Plan a meeting and prepare the agenda
meeting-plan.summary: Create the meeting, let Memoria suggest agenda items from open matters and check the legal deadlines.
meeting-plan.keywords: meeting plan new board meeting junta general meeting agm agenda order of the day invitation convocation suggest agenda schedule
steps: Click the tab "🗓️ Meetings".
Click "+ New meeting".
Type the "Title", choose the "Type" (board meeting or general meeting), the "Date" and optionally "Time" and "Place / link".
Click "Save". The agenda of the new meeting opens.
Click "💡 Suggest agenda from open items". Memoria lists open matters: urgent expenses to ratify, contracts with close deadlines, tenders to decide, blocked or overdue tasks.
Untick what should not be on the agenda and click "Add selected".
To add your own point, type it in "Add item", choose the type and click "+ Add item". Use ▲ and ▼ to change the order, ✕ to remove.
Under the meeting you see whether the invitation deadline is met (for example "Send the invitation by …").
tips: When the invitation has been sent, click "Edit" and fill "Invitation sent on"; the check turns green.
Board meetings need 8 days' notice, general meetings 15 days (Statutes).

meeting-print.title: Print the invitation or the minutes of a meeting
meeting-print.summary: Memoria prepares a printable invitation and minutes; you can also save them as PDF.
meeting-print.keywords: print invitation convocation minutes acta pdf save meeting paper send owners
steps: Click the tab "🗓️ Meetings".
On the meeting, click "▸ Agenda".
Click "🖨 Print invitation". Your browser's print window opens.
Choose a printer, or choose "Save as PDF" as the destination to get a file.
After the meeting has been held, use "🖨 Print minutes" in the same place.
tips: "🖨 Print minutes" appears only when the meeting status is "Held".

meeting-outcome.title: After a meeting: record what was decided
meeting-outcome.summary: Write the outcome of each agenda item and turn decisions into records and follow-up tasks.
meeting-outcome.keywords: meeting outcome result held after the meeting record decision minutes agenda item vote resolution follow-up task
steps: Click the tab "🗓️ Meetings", find the meeting and click "Edit".
Set "Status" to "Held", fill "Present" and "Quorum reached", then click "Save".
Click "▸ Agenda". Each item now has an "Outcome" box.
Type what was decided and click "Save outcome".
For a decision, click "⚖️ Record as decision". It is saved in "⚖️ Decisions".
Memoria asks whether to create a follow-up task. Click OK; the task appears in "✅ Follow-up".
tips: Faster: if the minutes are already written, use "📄 Import minutes (AI)" instead (see the guide "Import the minutes of a meeting").

minutes-import.title: Import the minutes of a meeting (AI)
minutes-import.summary: Upload the approved minutes; the AI proposes agenda points, decisions and tasks with deadlines; you check and save.
minutes-import.keywords: minutes acta import upload pdf word document transcript teams ai read meeting decisions tasks deadlines automatically
steps: Click the tab "🗓️ Meetings".
Click "📄 Import minutes (AI)" (at the top, or inside a meeting's agenda).
Click "📎 Choose file (PDF, Word or photo)" and choose the approved minutes. You can also paste the text and click "🤖 Read the pasted text".
Wait up to a minute while "AI is reading the minutes…" is shown.
Check "1 · Meeting": is it the right meeting and date?
Check "2 · Agenda points and decisions": untick what should not be saved and correct any text.
Check "3 · New tasks with deadlines": who does it and by when. Dates marked "please check" were calculated by the AI.
Check "4 · Progress on existing tasks" if it appears.
Click "✓ Save the ticked items", then "OK". The minutes file is attached to the meeting.
tips: Nothing is saved until you click save. The AI only copies what the minutes say; it does not add or judge anything.
Tick "Mark as DEMO (sample data)" when you only want to try it.

decision-new.title: Record a decision of the board or the general meeting
decision-new.summary: The decision log: what was decided, by whom, why, the options considered and the votes.
decision-new.keywords: decision resolution record agreement acuerdo vote approved board decided why reason options log register new
steps: Click the tab "⚖️ Decisions".
Click "+ New decision".
Type the "Title" and check the "Date of decision".
Choose "Decided by" (for example "Board" or "General Meeting").
Fill "Context / problem", "Options considered", the "Decision" itself and "Why".
Type the votes in "For", "Against" and "Abstained".
Under "Related suppliers", click the names of the suppliers concerned.
Click "Save".
tips: Decisions are also created from a meeting ("⚖️ Record as decision") and from imported minutes.
Use "Search…" at the top to find old decisions by any word.

decision-link.title: Link a decision to a tender, contract or task, and review it later
decision-link.summary: Show which decision approved a tender or contract, follow its tasks, and note later how it worked out.
decision-link.keywords: decision link connect tender contract task approved by decision follow up review looking back superseded suspended status
steps: Tender: open "🧾 Tenders & quotes", click "Edit" on the tender, choose the decision in "Approved by decision", click "Save".
Contract: open "📑 Contracts", click "Edit", choose the decision in "Approved by decision", click "Save".
Task: in "✅ Follow-up", when you create or edit a task, choose the decision in "Resolution / decision".
On the decision card you then see "✅ Follow-up tasks" with how many are done.
Later, click "Edit" on the decision and fill "Looking back: how did it work out?" and "Reviewed on".
If the decision was replaced, change "Status" (for example "Superseded") and explain in "Status note".

mandate-new.title: Record a board member's mandate and give access
mandate-new.summary: Who holds which position and since when; give a new board member access to Memoria.
mandate-new.keywords: board member mandate position president vice-president new member access give access add user elected term
steps: Click the tab "👥 Board & mandates".
Click "+ New mandate".
Choose the person's "Mi Hacienda account" (their name fills in), or type the "Name".
Choose the "Position" (for example "President").
Fill "Elected / appointed by", "Start of mandate" and "Planned end".
Click "Save".
On the new card, click "Give board access" and confirm. The person can now open Memoria.
tips: The person must first register in Mi Hacienda and be approved, so that their account can be linked.

mandate-end.title: When a mandate ends: remove access (new board)
mandate-end.summary: Close the old mandate and remove Memoria access from members who left the board.
mandate-end.keywords: mandate end remove access leave board resign handover new board outgoing former member revoke
steps: First give access to the new board members (see "Record a board member's mandate and give access").
Click the tab "👥 Board & mandates".
On the outgoing member's card click "Edit", fill "Actual end (resignation, removal)" if the mandate ended early, and click "Save".
The card moves to "Previous mandates" and a red button "Remove board access" appears.
Click "Remove board access" and confirm. The person stays an owner in Mi Hacienda but no longer sees Memoria.
tips: You cannot remove your own access; another board member has to do it.
Memoria warns in "Needs attention" when someone still has access after the mandate ended.

email-settings.title: E-mail reminders: switch on or off, see a sample
email-settings.summary: Weekly summary, deadline reminders and the monthly report by e-mail.
email-settings.keywords: email e-mail reminders notifications weekly summary monthly report digest switch off unsubscribe sample stop emails
steps: Click the tab "👥 Board & mandates" and scroll to the bottom, to "✉️ Email reminders".
Tick or untick "Send me Memoria reminders by email". The change is saved at once.
To see what the e-mails look like, click "Send me a sample summary now" or "Send me the monthly report now".
Check your inbox for the message.
tips: Every Monday: a weekly summary. First working day of the month: the monthly report. Other days: an e-mail only when a deadline is close.
Automatic sending starts only when the board starts using Memoria.

case-new.title: Record an insurance claim or a dispute
case-new.summary: Follow claims and disputes: amounts, status, and the next step with its deadline.
case-new.keywords: claim insurance dispute complaint warranty legal lawyer case damage leak supplier conflict recover money next step
steps: Click the tab "🛡️ Claims & disputes".
Click "+ New case".
Choose the "Type" (for example "Insurance claim") and type the "Title".
In "Other party" type the insurer or company. Never type an owner's name.
Fill "Reference (claim, policy, case no.)", "Opened on" and "Amount claimed (EUR)".
Fill "Next step", "Next step by" and "Responsible".
Click "Save".
Each time something happens: click "▸ Show details", type in "What happened? (Enter to add)" and press Enter.
At the end, click "Edit", set "Status" (for example "Settled") and fill "Amount recovered (EUR)".

supplier-new.title: Add a supplier and check for conflicts of interest
supplier-new.summary: Record a company the community works with, including the conflict-of-interest check.
supplier-new.keywords: supplier new add company provider contractor vendor firm conflict of interest check tax id nif cif contact
steps: Click the tab "🏢 Suppliers".
Click "+ New supplier".
Type the "Company name" and choose the "Category" (for example "Pools").
Fill "Tax ID (NIF/CIF)", "Contact person", "Phone" and "Email".
After checking that the company is not an owner, the administrator or a related company, tick "Conflict of interest checked" and write how you checked in "Conflict check note".
Click "Save".
tips: Suppliers are also created automatically when the AI reads a quote, contract or invoice.
An active supplier without the check appears in "Needs attention".

supplier-find.title: Find a supplier, for example all pool companies
supplier-find.summary: Search and filter the list of suppliers, and see their ratings and decisions.
supplier-find.keywords: find search supplier list pool companies gardening electrician plumber filter category contact phone who is our
steps: Click the tab "🏢 Suppliers".
Type a name or word in "Search…", or choose a category in "Category: All" (for example "Pools").
Use "Status: All" to see only "Active" suppliers.
Click "▸ Show details" on a supplier to see its tax ID, notes, ratings and "Related decisions".
tips: Their quotes are in "🧾 Tenders & quotes", their contracts in "📑 Contracts" and their invoices in "💶 Invoices".

supplier-rate.title: Rate a supplier
supplier-rate.summary: Give stars and a comment, so future boards know how a supplier performed.
supplier-rate.keywords: rate rating stars review evaluate supplier performance quality comment score
steps: Click the tab "🏢 Suppliers" and find the supplier.
Click "▸ Show details".
Under "Ratings", click "+ Add rating".
Choose the stars in "Rating", write a "Comment" and check the "Date".
Click "Save". The average stars on the supplier update.

tender-new.title: Start a tender to collect quotes for a job
tender-new.summary: One record per job: collect several quotes, compare them and record the choice.
tender-new.keywords: tender new job quotes request for quotes bids offers compare prices licitacion concurso start collect budget pool cleaning maintenance
steps: Click the tab "🧾 Tenders & quotes".
Click "+ New tender".
Type the "Title", for example "Pool maintenance 2027", and a "Description" of the job.
Optionally type the "Category" and the "Approved budget".
Click "Save". The tender has the status "Collecting quotes".
Next: add the quotes (see "Add quotes to a tender (AI reads the PDFs)").
tips: The community rule is to compare at least 2 quotes; Memoria warns when a tender is decided with fewer.

quotes-upload.title: Add quotes to a tender (AI reads the PDFs)
quotes-upload.summary: Upload up to 5 quote PDFs or photos; the AI reads supplier, price, VAT and conditions; you check and save.
quotes-upload.keywords: add quote upload pdf photo offer budget presupuesto ai read scan supplier price vat conditions quotes new
steps: Click the tab "🧾 Tenders & quotes" and find the tender.
Click "▸ Show details".
Click "🤖 Upload quotes (AI reads them)" and choose up to 5 files (PDF or photo).
Wait 10–20 seconds while the AI reads them.
Under "Check what AI read", check each quote: supplier, "Amount", "VAT included", dates and "Scope and conditions". Fields marked ⚠ were unclear.
If the supplier is new, Memoria creates it; check its name and tax ID.
Untick any file that is not a quote and click "Save selected quotes", then "OK".
tips: Without AI: click "+ Add quote" and type the supplier and amount yourself (the supplier must exist in "🏢 Suppliers").
The original PDF is kept; click "📄 PDF" in the quotes table to open it.

quotes-find.title: Find all quotes for a job (for example pool cleaning)
quotes-find.summary: Where the quotes are, how to see them side by side and open the original PDFs.
quotes-find.keywords: find see all quotes offers bids prices pool cleaning pool maintenance where are the quotes list tender compare ofertas presupuestos piscina limpieza
steps: Click the tab "🧾 Tenders & quotes".
In "Search…" type a word from the job, for example "pool".
Click "▸ Show details" on the tender. The table "Quotes" lists every quote, cheapest first, with the labels "lowest" and "over budget".
Click "📄 PDF" next to a quote to open the original document.
Click "⇆ Compare conditions" to see the conditions of the quotes side by side.
To get an analysis, see "Compare quotes and get an AI analysis".
tips: You can also ask in "💬 Ask Memoria": "Show me all quotes for pool cleaning".
Quotes of older jobs stay in their tenders; use "Status: All" to include decided tenders.

quotes-analyse.title: Compare quotes and get an AI analysis
quotes-analyse.summary: With two or more quotes, the AI compares prices per year, risks, missing information and the procedure. It never chooses.
quotes-analyse.keywords: analysis analyse analyze compare quotes which is cheaper best offer comparison ai evaluate risks questions for suppliers price per year
steps: Click the tab "🧾 Tenders & quotes", find the tender and click "▸ Show details".
Check the "Quotes" table. A warning appears if some prices include VAT and others do not.
In the box "🔎 Quote analysis (AI)", click "Analyse the quotes (AI)".
Wait 20–40 seconds.
Read "Summary", "Comparable prices" (price per year with and without VAT), "Risks", "Missing information", "Questions for the suppliers" and "Procedure".
The analysis is saved on the tender, so all board members can read it.
If a quote changes, click "Run again".
tips: The AI points out facts, risks and questions. The choice and its reason belong to the board.

tender-choose.title: Choose the supplier and record why
tender-choose.summary: After the board decides, mark the chosen quote and write the reason.
tender-choose.keywords: choose winner select supplier award decided reason why chosen close tender selection
steps: First record the board's decision in "⚖️ Decisions".
Click the tab "🧾 Tenders & quotes", find the tender and click "▸ Show details".
In the "Quotes" table, click "Choose this one" on the chosen quote.
A window asks "Why is this supplier chosen?". Type the reason and click OK.
The tender becomes "Decided".
Click "Edit" on the tender, choose the decision in "Approved by decision" and click "Save".
Then add the contract in "📑 Contracts" and choose this tender in "Tender".
tips: A decided tender without a reason, or with fewer than 2 quotes, appears in "Needs attention".

contract-new.title: Add a contract (the AI can read it)
contract-new.summary: Record a contract with dates, automatic renewal and notice period; Memoria reminds you before the notice deadline.
contract-new.keywords: contract new add upload pdf agreement service contract renewal automatic notice period end date supplier ai read
steps: Click the tab "📑 Contracts".
With the PDF: click "🤖 Upload contract (AI reads it)" and choose the file. Wait up to a minute; the form opens already filled in.
Without the PDF: click "+ New contract".
Check or fill "Supplier", "Subject", "Starts" and "Ends".
If it renews by itself, tick "Renews automatically" and type the "Notice period (days)".
Fill "Amount", "Payment" and "Signed by"; choose "Approved by decision" and "Tender".
Click "Save". When the AI read a file, the file is attached to the contract.
tips: If the supplier is not in Memoria yet, click "+ Create supplier" in the green box.

contract-notice.title: When must we give notice on a contract?
contract-notice.summary: Memoria calculates the last day to cancel a contract that renews automatically, and reminds you.
contract-notice.keywords: notice cancel terminate contract renewal deadline last day to give notice end contract expire expiring auto renew
steps: Click the tab "📑 Contracts".
Contracts that renew by themselves show "↻ Renews automatically".
When the deadline is less than 60 days away, the card shows a red "Give notice by" with the date.
The same dates appear in "📅 Calendar" ("Last day to give notice") and in "Needs attention" on Today.
The reminder e-mails arrive 30, 14, 7 and 1 day before.
tips: The date is only calculated when the contract has an end date, "Renews automatically" is ticked and the "Notice period (days)" is filled.

invoices-import.title: Import invoices from the administrator's export
invoices-import.summary: Upload the administrator's Excel, CSV or PDF list; Memoria matches suppliers and categories; you check and import.
invoices-import.keywords: import invoices administrator export excel csv xlsx pdf list monthly upload facturas load spending accounts
steps: Click the tab "💶 Invoices".
Click "📥 Import from the administrator".
Click "Choose a file" and choose the administrator's file (Excel, CSV, PDF or photo). You can also paste the table and click "Read pasted text".
For Excel or CSV: check which column is the date, supplier, invoice number and total, look at the "Preview" and click "Continue".
In the review table, check the supplier and "Category" of each row. Rows already in Memoria are skipped automatically.
Untick rows that should not be imported.
Click "Import … invoices", then "OK".
tips: A mistake? Under "🗂 Previous imports" click "Undo import" and import again.
The administrator's data usually arrives about one month late.

invoice-single.title: Add one invoice from a photo or PDF
invoice-single.summary: The AI reads a single invoice and fills in the form; you check and save.
invoice-single.keywords: invoice new add one single photo pdf scan receipt bill factura ai read manual
steps: Click the tab "💶 Invoices".
Click "🤖 Invoice from photo or PDF" and choose the file.
Wait up to a minute; the form "New invoice" opens already filled in.
Check every field: supplier, "Invoice no.", "Invoice date", amounts, "Category" and "Paid from".
Click "Save". The file is attached to the invoice.
Without a file: click "+ New invoice" and type the values; only "Total" is required.

invoice-urgent.title: Urgent unbudgeted expense and its ratification
invoice-urgent.summary: Mark an urgent expense approved by the President and Administrator, and record when the board ratified it.
invoice-urgent.keywords: urgent emergency repair unbudgeted expense ratify ratification article 30 president administrator approve after
steps: Click the tab "💶 Invoices" and find the invoice.
Click "Edit" and tick "Urgent unbudgeted expense".
Explain in "Why it was urgent" and click "Save". The invoice shows "Urgent · Not yet ratified" and is suggested for the next meeting's agenda.
After the board ratifies it (record the decision), click "Edit" again on the invoice.
In "Ratified by decision" choose that decision and click "Save". The badge becomes "Urgent · ✓".
tips: Tick "Only unratified urgent expenses" above the list to see what is still waiting.

invoice-find.title: Find invoices and see totals
invoice-find.summary: Filter invoices by year, category, supplier or payment status; the total of the list is shown.
invoice-find.keywords: find invoices search filter year category supplier paid unpaid pending total how much did we spend cost spending
steps: Click the tab "💶 Invoices".
Type a supplier, number or word in "Search…".
Use "Year: All", "Category: All", "Payment status: All" and "Paid from: All" to narrow the list.
Above the list, "Total of the invoices shown" gives the sum.
Click "▸ Show details" on an invoice to see its contract, tender and attachments.
tips: For costs over several years, ask "💬 Ask Memoria" or use "📊 Overview".

list-export.title: Filter invoices, suppliers or quotes and export them to Excel
list-export.summary: Show only what you need (for example all 2026 pool invoices of one supplier) and download exactly that list as an Excel file.
list-export.keywords: export excel download filter filtered list xlsx spreadsheet invoices suppliers quotes tenders contracts report table csv print save copy
steps: Open the list you need: "💶 Invoices", "🏢 Suppliers", "🧾 Tenders & quotes" or "📑 Contracts".

Set the filters above the list, for example "Year: All" → 2026, "Supplier: All" → the supplier, "Category: All" → Pools. You can also type a word in "Search…". To export everything (for example all suppliers), leave every filter on "All" and the search empty.
Check that the list shows what you want. The button "⬇ Excel" shows how many records will be exported, for example "⬇ Excel (12)".
Click "⬇ Excel". The file is downloaded to your computer (usually into the Downloads folder).
Open the file in Excel, Numbers or Google Sheets. The first sheet "Info" says when it was exported, which filters were used, how many records it contains and, for invoices, the total.

For tenders the file has two sheets: the tenders and all their quotes (supplier, amount, VAT, valid until, chosen or not). With "Supplier: All" set to one supplier, only that supplier's quotes are exported.
tips: Amounts stay numbers and dates are written as YYYY-MM-DD, so you can sort and add them up in Excel.
Rows marked DEMO = yes are sample data.
For a copy of everything in Memoria, use "💾 Export" instead.

budget-setup.title: Record the budget and follow spending by category
budget-setup.summary: Enter the approved budget and its lines; Memoria compares them with the invoices.
budget-setup.keywords: budget annual approved presupuesto category lines planned actual over budget spending forecast pace
steps: Click the tab "💰 Budget & reserve" and choose the "Year".
Click "+ Record the budget".
Fill "Name", "Approved total (EUR)", "Approved on" and "Approved by decision", then click "Save".
For each category: choose it in "Add category…", type the amount and click "+ Add".
The table "By category" now shows budget, invoiced, full-year pace and a status: "On track", "May exceed" or "Over budget".
To change a line, click its amount, type the new one and click ✓.
tips: Only invoices paid from the "Ordinary budget" count here.

reserve.title: Follow the reserve fund
reserve.summary: Record the opening balance and movements; Memoria compares the balance with the legal minimum.
reserve.keywords: reserve fund fondo de reserva balance minimum legal 10 percent contribution withdrawal opening balance
steps: Click the tab "💰 Budget & reserve" and scroll to "🏦 Reserve fund".
Click "+ Add movement".
For the start, choose "Type" = "Opening balance", the "Date" and the "Amount (EUR)" given by the administrator. Click "Save".
Later, add "Contribution", "Interest" or "Withdrawal" movements that have no invoice.
Invoices marked "Paid from" = "Reserve fund" are subtracted automatically.
The badge shows "Below the minimum" or "Above the minimum".

board-report.title: Prepare the report for the next board meeting
board-report.summary: One click: what happened since the last meeting – decisions, tasks, invoices and payments, budget, new suppliers, tenders, contracts, claims and what comes next.
board-report.keywords: report meeting board preparation summary last month since last meeting monthly what happened overview briefing agenda documents paid invoices budget new suppliers decisions print pdf email
steps: Click the tab "🗒️ Meeting report" (group "Reports").
Memoria selects the period since the last board meeting. You can also click "Last month" or "Last 30 days", or set "From" and "To".

Read the report: the key figures at the top, then 1. Decisions, 2. Follow-up of tasks, 3. Invoices and payments, 4. Budget and reserve fund, 5. New suppliers, 6. Tenders and quotes, 7. Contracts, 8. Claims and disputes, 9. Meetings and what comes next.
Click "🖨 Print / PDF" to print it or save it as PDF for the meeting.
Or click "📋 Copy as text" and paste it into an e-mail to the board.
Or click "⬇ Excel" to get the same report as a spreadsheet.
tips: Nothing has to be filtered or copied by hand; the report always uses the current records.
Red lines need attention (overdue, over budget, not ratified); orange lines are coming up.
The report shows facts only. Decisions stay with the board.

overview.title: Overview report for one category (for example gardening)
overview.summary: Which companies worked for us, their contracts, whether quotes were compared, why each was chosen and what is missing.
overview.keywords: overview report category period gardening pools history companies contracts quotes compared why chosen missing information print csv
steps: Click the tab "📊 Overview".
Choose the "Category" (for example "Pools").
Set "From" and "To". The report updates at once.
Read the cards: each contract with duration, amount, number of quotes and "Why chosen".
The orange card "Missing information" lists what is not recorded yet.
Click "Print / PDF" to print it or "Export CSV" to open it in Excel.

handover.title: Prepare the handover pack for a new board
handover.summary: One document with everything a new board needs on day one.
handover.keywords: handover new board new president transition summary pack document print pdf continuity
steps: Click "📦 Prepare handover pack" on Today, or the tab "📦 Handover pack".
Wait a moment while it is prepared.
Click "🖨 Print / PDF" and choose a printer or "Save as PDF".
Section 10 lists what must be handed over outside the system (keys, bank signatures, original documents).

activity.title: See who changed what
activity.summary: Every change in Memoria is logged automatically and cannot be edited or deleted.
activity.keywords: activity log history who changed what audit trail deleted edited when changes who changed modified edited contract record person user
steps: Click the tab "🕒 Activity".
Changes are grouped by day: time, name, what was added, updated or deleted.
For updates, "Changed:" lists the fields.
Click "Load older" at the bottom to see earlier changes.

usage.title: See how much each board member used Memoria
usage.summary: Visits, days, time, records added or changed and AI requests per board member, for any period – and everything as Excel.
usage.keywords: usage use statistics who worked how much time hours visits logins activity per person member trial evaluation report export excel log who made records
steps: Click the tab "📈 Usage" (group "Reports").
Choose the period: "Trial Oct–Dec 2026", "This month", "Last 30 days", "Since the start", or set "From" and "To" yourself.
The table shows for each board member: "Visits", "Days used", "Time (h:mm)", records "Added", "Changed" and "Deleted", "AI requests" and the "Last visit". The last row is the total.
Click "⬇ Excel: summary, visits and all changes" to download everything for that period.

The Excel file has four sheets: "Info" (period), "Summary" (the table), "Visits" (every visit with start, last activity, minutes and screens used) and "Changes" (every record added, changed or deleted: when, who, what).
tips: Time counts only while Memoria is open and someone is working; after 10 minutes without activity the visit ends.
All board members see the same figures; nobody can change or delete them.
Records marked DEMO are not counted. Time is measured from this version on; earlier work appears in the changes.

export.title: Download everything (backup)
export.summary: One ZIP with all records in Excel and all attached documents, independent of the app.
export.keywords: export download backup copy zip excel all data documents archive save everything
steps: Click the tab "💾 Export".
Click "💾 Download everything (ZIP)".
Wait while it is prepared; with many documents it can take a few minutes.
Save the ZIP in a safe place, for example the community's own drive.
tips: The ZIP contains memoria.xlsx (one sheet per table), memoria.json, all documents and a README.

attachments.title: Attach a document to any record
attachments.summary: Add a PDF, photo or link to a task, meeting, decision, supplier, tender, contract or invoice.
attachments.keywords: attach attachment document file upload pdf photo link add document store save file
steps: Open the record (for example a contract) and click "▸ Show details".
Under "📎 Attachments", click "+ Add attachment".
Click "File (max 25 MB)" and choose the file, or paste a web address in "…or link".
Optionally type a "Title", choose the "Type" and the "Document date".
Click "Save".
To open it later, click its name in "📎 Attachments".
tips: Files are stored privately; only the board can open them.
